value.rationale: The minimal graph perturbation of attaching one leaf to a complete graph exchanges an exceptional central-binomial population between long transient consensus and persistent two-cycles with clique parity. An all-size exact first-entry/attractor census and asymptotic probability are meaningful dynamical invariants beyond the textbook eventual period-two property.
